build_trainer: build an Alphafold3 trainer with EMA, gradient accumulation, and distributed training via Lightning Fabric
train_model: train an Alphafold3 model with custom optimizer, learning rate scheduler, and gradient clipping
save_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint with model, optimizer, scheduler states and step count to a folder
load_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint from a file or directory, restoring model, optimizer, and scheduler state
validate_model: validate an Alphafold3 model on a validation dataset using the EMA model with loss breakdown logging
